<script>
// This function limits the book now shows to only show one week at a time.
var BOOKNOWWEEK=0; //week currently showing
var BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS=2; //how many weeks to show at once
function showBookNowByWeek(week){
    if (week) BOOKNOWWEEK += week;
    jQuery('.dot_events_times tr').hide();
    var numprevshows = 0;
    var numnextshows = 0;
    for (var w=0; w<BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS; w++) {
        jQuery('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK+w)).show();
        // Count number of shows in the previous and next weeks and hide the 
        // "more" div if there aren't any (eg show is all this week).
        numprevshows += jQuery ('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK-1-w)).length;
        numnextshows += jQuery ('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK+BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS+w)).length;
    }
    if (!numprevshows && !numnextshows) {jQuery('#more_shows').hide();}
    // Show or hide the previous button
    var prevel = jQuery('.dot_events_prev');
    if (numprevshows) prevel.show(); else prevel.hide();
    // Show or hide the next button
    var nextel = jQuery('.dot_events_next');
    if (numnextshows) nextel.show(); else nextel.hide();
}

//From 24/3/2025 do a popup which the customer must agree for the following classes
var DOTEVENTSPOPUPCLASSES = {
    'dot_events_performancetype_audio_described' : ['audio described', "Please note, this performance will feature live audio description of what is happening onstage available through headphones. For best seats for Audio Description, please choose the seats labelled 'Best for ADP'."],
    'dot_events_performancetype_relaxed_distanced': ['relaxed', 'Please note, this is a relaxed performance. There will be seats intentionally left empty, house lights will remain dim throughout, and sound cues will be made quieter. For more information, <a href="https://orangetreetheatre.co.uk/your-visit/access/">see here</a>.'],
    'dot_events_performancetype_captioned': ['captioned', 'Please note, this performance is captioned. We reserve seats specifically in a position to be able to best view the captions. Please call the Box Office to book these seats on 020 8940 3633']
};
	
function addPopupQuestions(classes) {
    jQuery('div.grid-container').append('<div class="popup-overlay" style="display:none"><div><p class="popup-continue"><a class="popup-continue-button">Book this <span class="popup-adjectives"></span> performance*</a></p><p>or</p><p class="popup-choose-another"><a class="popup-choose-another-button">Choose another date</p><p class="popup-descriptions"></p></div></div>');
    // Make a string from the keys eg td.dot_spektrix_audiodescribed a, td...
    var classString = Object.keys(classes).map(function(k){return 'td.'+k+' a';}).join(', ');
    // Create an onclick for all these classes and build two arrays of strings for
    // placing in the popup description and listing what the attributes mean
    jQuery(classString).click(function(event){
        event.preventDefault();
        var myHref = jQuery(this).attr('href');
        jQuery('.popup-continue').click(function(){document.location.href=myHref;});
        jQuery('.popup-choose-another').click(function(){jQuery('div.popup-overlay').hide();});
        var popupAdjectives=[], popupDescriptions=[];
        var myClass = jQuery(this).parents('td').attr('class');
        for (k in classes) {
            if (myClass.indexOf(k)>=0) {
                popupAdjectives.push(classes[k][0]);
                popupDescriptions.push(classes[k][1]);
            }
        }
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay .popup-adjectives').html(popupAdjectives.join(', '));
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay .popup-descriptions').html('*'+popupDescriptions.join('</p><p>'));
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay').show();
        return false;
    });
}

//If we are on a shows page with book now links, then it sorts out the week-by-week navigation of the shows.
jQuery(document).ready(function(){
    // If this is a more shows element on this page
    if (jQuery('.dot_events_times tr').length) {
        var html = '<div class="dot_events_prev_next">';
        html += '<span class="dot_events_prev" onclick="showBookNowByWeek(-' + BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS + ')"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>';
        html += '<span class="dot_events_next" onclick="showBookNowByWeek(' + BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS + ')"><i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i></span>';
        html += '</div>';
        jQuery(html).insertAfter('table.dot_events_times');
        var week=0; // all this is to handle jumping to a specific week given a date hash
        if (window.location.hash) {
            var els = jQuery('tr.dot_events_day_' + window.location.hash.substr(1));
            if (els && els[0].className) {
                var pos = els[0].className.indexOf('dot_events_week_');
                if (pos>=0) {
                    var weeknum = parseInt(els[0].className.substring('dot_events_week_'.length));
                    if (weeknum > 0) week = weeknum;
                }               
            }
        }
        showBookNowByWeek(week);
    }

<script>
// This function limits the book now shows to only show one week at a time.
var BOOKNOWWEEK=0; //week currently showing
var BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS=2; //how many weeks to show at once
function showBookNowByWeek(week){
    if (week) BOOKNOWWEEK += week;
    jQuery('.dot_events_times tr').hide();
    var numprevshows = 0;
    var numnextshows = 0;
    for (var w=0; w<BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS; w++) {
        jQuery('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK+w)).show();
        // Count number of shows in the previous and next weeks and hide the 
        // "more" div if there aren't any (eg show is all this week).
        numprevshows += jQuery ('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK-1-w)).length;
        numnextshows += jQuery ('.dot_events_times tr.dot_events_week_' + (BOOKNOWWEEK+BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS+w)).length;
    }
    if (!numprevshows && !numnextshows) {jQuery('#more_shows').hide();}
    // Show or hide the previous button
    var prevel = jQuery('.dot_events_prev');
    if (numprevshows) prevel.show(); else prevel.hide();
    // Show or hide the next button
    var nextel = jQuery('.dot_events_next');
    if (numnextshows) nextel.show(); else nextel.hide();
}

//From 24/3/2025 do a popup which the customer must agree for the following classes
var DOTEVENTSPOPUPCLASSES = {
    'dot_events_performancetype_audio_described' : ['audio described', "Please note, this performance will feature live audio description of what is happening onstage available through headphones. For best seats for Audio Description, please choose the seats labelled 'Best for ADP'."],
    'dot_events_performancetype_relaxed_distanced': ['relaxed', 'Please note, this is a relaxed performance. There will be seats intentionally left empty, house lights will remain dim throughout, and sound cues will be made quieter. For more information, <a href="https://orangetreetheatre.co.uk/your-visit/access/">see here</a>.'],
    'dot_events_performancetype_captioned': ['captioned', 'Please note, this performance is captioned. We reserve seats specifically in a position to be able to best view the captions. Please call the Box Office to book these seats on 020 8940 3633']
};
	
function addPopupQuestions(classes) {
    jQuery('div.grid-container').append('<div class="popup-overlay" style="display:none"><div><p class="popup-continue"><a class="popup-continue-button">Book this <span class="popup-adjectives"></span> performance*</a></p><p>or</p><p class="popup-choose-another"><a class="popup-choose-another-button">Choose another date</p><p class="popup-descriptions"></p></div></div>');
    // Make a string from the keys eg td.dot_spektrix_audiodescribed a, td...
    var classString = Object.keys(classes).map(function(k){return 'td.'+k+' a';}).join(', ');
    // Create an onclick for all these classes and build two arrays of strings for
    // placing in the popup description and listing what the attributes mean
    jQuery(classString).click(function(event){
        event.preventDefault();
        var myHref = jQuery(this).attr('href');
        jQuery('.popup-continue').click(function(){document.location.href=myHref;});
        jQuery('.popup-choose-another').click(function(){jQuery('div.popup-overlay').hide();});
        var popupAdjectives=[], popupDescriptions=[];
        var myClass = jQuery(this).parents('td').attr('class');
        for (k in classes) {
            if (myClass.indexOf(k)>=0) {
                popupAdjectives.push(classes[k][0]);
                popupDescriptions.push(classes[k][1]);
            }
        }
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay .popup-adjectives').html(popupAdjectives.join(', '));
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay .popup-descriptions').html('*'+popupDescriptions.join('</p><p>'));
        jQuery('div.popup-overlay').show();
        return false;
    });
}

//If we are on a shows page with book now links, then it sorts out the week-by-week navigation of the shows.
jQuery(document).ready(function(){
    // If this is a more shows element on this page
    if (jQuery('.dot_events_times tr').length) {
        var html = '<div class="dot_events_prev_next">';
        html += '<span class="dot_events_prev" onclick="showBookNowByWeek(-' + BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS + ')"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>';
        html += '<span class="dot_events_next" onclick="showBookNowByWeek(' + BOOKNOWNUMWEEKS + ')"><i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i></span>';
        html += '</div>';
        jQuery(html).insertAfter('table.dot_events_times');
        var week=0; // all this is to handle jumping to a specific week given a date hash
        if (window.location.hash) {
            var els = jQuery('tr.dot_events_day_' + window.location.hash.substr(1));
            if (els && els[0].className) {
                var pos = els[0].className.indexOf('dot_events_week_');
                if (pos>=0) {
                    var weeknum = parseInt(els[0].className.substring('dot_events_week_'.length));
                    if (weeknum > 0) week = weeknum;
                }               
            }
        }
        showBookNowByWeek(week);
    }

});
